notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Mimic Vat.
description:
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Ashnod's Altar, generating two generic mana.
Imprint Mimic Vat with Dross Scorpion.
Activate Mimic Vat for 1 mana, creating a token copy of Dross Scorpion.
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Ashnod's Altar, and target Mimic Vat with its death trigger.
